notes.title: New Fighter added to Beatdown City Survivors Demo Update #2!
notes.content:
[p]First off, thank you to everyone checking out the demo! If you played it, PLEASE give us a review.[/p][p]
[/p][p]We’ve been very happy with how the demos been going, we’re extending our demo for a few more weeks[b]![/b][/p][p](For access to Playtests, consider joining our discord and signing up! [url="https://discord.gg/BK57QbFgfG"]https://discord.gg/BK57QbFgfG[/url])[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518186/4da73c6a65775b221352d3fa6ac4dba0acee6cc8.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Our latest character, Julie Chu, can now be unlocked![/h2][list][*][p]Julie is a judo master, with a 360 attack, doing damage to everyone around her![/p][/*][*][p]She also has a unique roll that does melee damage to enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Her [b]skill[/b] increases the area of all of her attacks.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Her unlock requirements require you to play as Lisa, Brad and Bruce for at least 5 minutes each.[/p][list][*][p]We just added counting time to the game, so even if you already played as Brad/Bruce/Lisa, you'll still have to do the 5 minutes each again.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Other Fixes[/h2][h3][b]Character Unlocks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We made unlocking Heather and Abbey easier. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Missions[/b][/h3][p]Destroying Vans counts over repeated playthroughs. [/p][list][*][p]Now if you destroy 1 or more vans and die, it will count for your next run.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now toggle off the Now Playing box if you want. It is also localized.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Controls" to the menu. [/p][list][*][p]We’re in the process of making controls rebindable. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]We updated how outlines load so they update immediately when you change the options. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated status effect icons, added Julie's Area Up icon (for her skill)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]MISC[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing E to close pause menu would also immediately interact with what you were next to[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Farooq item/upgrade cards would be incorrectly left in selected state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where if a shop had an upgrade for a weapon, then you crafted that weapon into something else, the upgrade in the shop would be broken[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Now Playing box would cause the game to hang if you were in a menu (Thanks IGN Live players!)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased performance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And that's it for now! Please continue to give us feedback, either on the Steam forums, or our [url="https://discord.gg/KHU97eTF"]discord![/url][/p]

notes.title: Beatdown City Survivors Demo Update 0.0.174 - Updates & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
0.0.174

Hello fighters of Beatdown City!

Thank you to everyone who has been playing our demo! The feedback has been amazing. If you haven't, make sure to grab it today!

Yesterday we launched a new trailer showing off what's possible in the demo, including one of the midbosses and the stage boss.

[previewyoutube=bCbZ_g0vmxg;full][/previewyoutube]

Today we're releasing our first update for the Beatdown City Survivors demo that brings a lot of improvements, upgrades, and some bug fixes. We’re always down for recommendations (like auto attack auto-targeting), but please keep them respectful. 

Also to note, because this is a demo, it doesn't appear that we can associate patch notes with it, so here they are!

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[h2]Missions[/h2]
[list]
[*]
Added a “Mission ticker” so it’s clearer in game what your first goals should be. 
[*]Mission ticker counts up as you achieve your goal. 
[*]Vans are now represented by a van icon at all times, making it clearer. 
[*]Decreased amount of vans, to allow more survivor/cop spawns.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518186/7c1042ea582deff86e293b1e468718d96db41e86.png[/img]

[list]
[*][h2]General Gameplay[/h2]
[*]Auto attack now does auto-target as well. 
[*]Sludge status effect (caused by soda) now nullifies shock. 
[/list]
[list][h2]UI[/h2]
[*]Added text to let players know how to unlock Heather and Abbey. 
[*]Added an arrow to point players to the PC, where you can upgrade your stats once unlocked.
[*]Updated text when player unlocks ability to upgrade stats.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518186/fe80aab5bdb045953c95536d942f0eae3bcb6122.png[/img]

[list][*][h2]Player Stats[/h2]
[*]The “luck” stat has been implemented, so you can now upgrade luck.
[*]Luck impacts finding items/money, amount/quality of upgrades on level up, as well as CRIT and DODGE chances.
[*]Tiger’s Eye upgrade (luck) is available during gameplay. 
[*]Every playable character has had a boost to default Re-roll amounts.
[*]1st tier of Farooq’s cart re-roll can be unlocked. 
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Data[/h2]
[*]Added a “quit” function that saves the amount of money you have when you quit to the base.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[*]Softlock when dying and leveling up simultaneously. 
[*]Removed ability to buy upgrades when player has max amount. 
[*]Sometimes abilities would be purchasable at a cart (during a run) but would not add to your weapon's overall level.
[/list]

That's it for today! We will have another update next week, featuring a new playable character, the Judo Fighter, Julie Chu!

Thanks for the feedback. 

If you have any suggestions, issues or any kind of feedback, please reach out!:
🤜 [url=https://discord.com/tibc]Discord.[/url]
🤜 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3383040/discussions/]Steam Community.[/url]

In the future, the Discord will be how to get access to more closed playtests to try out new weapons, players, stages, etc.
